title: 13 云城青布长衫14 超然感知
content_zh:
尘土渐渐落下。
官道上恢复了安静。
“恩公。”
周娘子沉默了一息，忽然轻声开口。
“刚才那个沈将军，不简单。”
曹笔看向她，好奇道：“他说自己是北境游击将军，这是个什么职位，品级高不高？”
周娘子想了想，开口道：“据妾身所知，大宁境内，一般的游击将军，都是从三品。”
她见曹笔没什么反应，便继续解释。
“大宁武官品级，从高到低，大致是总兵，副总兵，参将，游击，都司，守备，操守，千总，把总……游击将军，排在参将之后，都司之前，算是中上级别的武将。”
“从三品？”
曹笔念了一遍，对这个品级没什么概念。
周娘子看出他的疑惑，又补了一句：“恩公，这么说吧，云城的守备，是正五品。
游击将军，比守备高两级。”
曹笔没说话，因为他对五品也没什么概念。
周娘子继续道：“恩公，按常理来说，他一个从三品的游击将军，哪怕亲民，也不可能对一个陌生妇人如此客气，还赠送腰牌。
妾身猜测，他应该猜出了什么。”
曹笔：“哦？”
周娘子压低声音道：“他看似是在向妾身示好，其实是在对恩公示好。”
曹笔问：“你怎么知道？”
周娘子微微一笑，说出关键点：“他的眼睛！

他看妾身的时候，眼神客气，但也就是客气。
可他不经意看恩公的那几眼……”
她顿了顿。
“那眼神，不是看普通人的眼神，而且他明显观察了你手里的刀，像在确定什么！”
曹笔想起那个中年武将看他时的样子，确实不太一样，顿时若有所思。
……
接下来的路途，很顺利。
没有再遇到匪徒和埋伏，连流民都渐渐少了。
官道两旁开始出现田地，虽然荒了不少，但偶尔能看见有人在耕种。
远处的山脚下，隐约可见炊烟袅袅，是村庄。
不知走了多久，云城的轮廓终于清晰起来。
灰黑色的城墙，比远看更高大。
城门洞开着，进出的百姓络绎不绝。
周娘子勒住马，看向曹笔。
“恩公，云城到了。”
曹笔抬起头，灰墙，黑瓦，旌旗在风中猎猎作响。
马车缓缓靠近城门。
守门的士兵站得笔直，目光如刀，从车队上一一扫过。
一个什长模样的上前几步，抬起手。
“站住！例行盘查！”

护卫们勒住马，脸色都有些紧张，他们身上有伤，衣服上还沾着血迹，这要是被揪住盘问，少不得麻烦。
锦袍公子忽然策马上前，笑着拱了拱手。
content_en:
The dust gradually fell.
Quietness returned to the official road.
"Benefactor."
Madam Zhou was silent for a moment, then suddenly spoke softly.
"That General Shen just now was not simple."
Cao Bi looked at her and asked curiously: "He said he was a guerrilla general in the north. What kind of position is this? Is it a high rank?"
Madam Zhou thought for a while and then said: "As far as I know, the general guerrilla generals in Daning are from the third rank."
Seeing that Cao Bi had no reaction, she continued to explain.
"The ranks of military attachés in Daning, from high to low, are roughly general, deputy general, general, guerrilla, commander, garrison, conduct, chief qian, commander... The guerrilla generals are ranked after the generals and before the generals. They are considered to be middle-to-upper-level generals."
"From the third level?"
Cao Bi read it again and had no idea about this level.
Madam Zhou saw his doubts and added: "My benefactor, let's put it this way, Yuncheng's defense is at the fifth level.
Guerrilla general, two levels higher than garrison. "
Cao Bi said nothing because he had no idea about the fifth grade.
Mrs. Zhou continued: "My benefactor, according to common sense, he is a third-grade guerrilla general, even if he is close to the people, he cannot be so polite to a strange woman and give her a waist card.
I guessed that he must have guessed something. "
Cao Bi: "Oh?"
Madam Zhou lowered her voice and said, "It seems that he is showing kindness to my concubine, but in fact he is showing kindness to his benefactor."
Cao Bi asked: "How do you know?"
Madam Zhou smiled slightly and said the key point: "His eyes!
When he looked at me, his eyes were polite, but that was just polite.
But those few glances he inadvertently glanced at his benefactor..."
She paused.
"That look is not like looking at an ordinary person, and he was obviously observing the knife in your hand, as if he was confirming something!"
Cao Bi thought about the way the middle-aged general looked at him. It was indeed different, and he suddenly became thoughtful.
…
The rest of the journey went smoothly.
There were no more gangsters or ambushes, and even the number of refugees gradually decreased.
Fields began to appear on both sides of the official road. Although a lot of them were deserted, you could occasionally see people farming.
At the foot of the mountain in the distance, you can vaguely see the smoke curling up from cooking stoves, which is a village.
After walking for an unknown amount of time, the outline of Yuncheng finally became clear.
The gray-black city wall looks taller than it looks from a distance.
The city gate was open, and there was an endless stream of people coming in and out.
Madam Zhou reined in her horse and looked at Cao Bi.
"My benefactor, Yuncheng has arrived."
Cao Bi raised his head and saw gray walls, black tiles, and flags rustling in the wind.
The carriage slowly approached the city gate.
The soldiers guarding the gate stood straight, their eyes like knives, scanning the convoy one by one.
A tall-looking man stepped forward and raised his hand.
"Stop! Routine inspection!"
The guards reined in their horses and looked a little nervous. They had injuries on their bodies and blood stains on their clothes. It would be troublesome if they were caught and questioned.
The brocade-robed young master suddenly rode forward, smiling and cupping his hands.
